root_causes.title: blockers field has no serde(default) but schema does not require it

detail.failure_mode: If LLM omits `blockers` field (not in schema required array), serde_json::from_value fails with 'missing field `blockers`'
detail.reproduction: JSON without 'blockers' key → serde error → assess() returns SerializationError
detail.fix: Add #[serde(default)] to blockers field so it defaults to empty Vec when missing

root_causes.category_label: schema/serde mismatch — schema requires field not in Rust type
root_causes.title: Schema requires 'recommendation' field not present in Rust ProgressAssessmentProposal

detail.impact: NOT a parse failure (serde ignores unknown fields by default). However, the LLM must output a field that is semantically redundant with the boolean flags (replan_recommended, completion_recommended). This creates prompt confusion.
detail.fix: Either add recommendation field to Rust struct with #[serde(default)], or remove from schema. Recommendation: add it as optional string with default.

root_causes.title: max_evaluator_invocations NOT enforced before provider spawn

detail.current_behavior: Calls evaluator.assess() once. On error, logs and continues with None. No durable count check before spawn. No retry. No budget enforcement.
detail.gap: evaluator.assess() always spawns provider regardless of prior attempts
detail.durable_invocation_rows: Written in call_adapter() BEFORE spawn, updated AFTER completion
detail.restart_behavior: After crash+restart, in-memory counter resets to 0. Durable rows exist but are not counted before next spawn.
detail.fix: Before calling evaluator.assess(), count durable evaluator invocations for this goal. If count >= max, skip evaluator and proceed to CompletionPolicy with existing evidence.

root_causes.title: Prompt says 'no markdown fences' but parser handles them — conflicting instructions

detail.prompt_text: Do NOT wrap it in markdown fences (no ```json). Do NOT add any text before or after the JSON.
detail.parser_behavior: try_extract_json handles markdown fences via Strategy 2 (fence stripping)
detail.impact: LLM may still output fences despite prompt instruction. Parser handles this correctly. Not a bug, but the prompt rigidity could cause the LLM to second-guess its output format.
detail.recommendation: Change prompt to: 'Output raw JSON. If you must use fences, they will be stripped automatically.'

root_causes.title: No retry classification — all evaluator errors treated identically

detail.current_behavior: Single attempt. Any error → None → fallback to task-count policy.
detail.missing: Distinction between transient provider errors (retryable) vs schema/semantic errors (non-retryable but consumes budget) vs capture bugs (should not retry)
detail.fix: Classify errors: provider transient → retry up to budget; schema violation → record and stop; capture bug → stop immediately
